title: PRESENCE IN ABSENCE
author: Dilip Mohapatra
text:
Time
Time, how lucky are you
Your own timekeeper
With none to question you
And none to answer to!
If you were a person
What would you do
With all of you
Belonging to you?
Would you prefer
Your own company
Or would crave for
Something transitory?
Will pain and pleasure
Matter to you as much
If you had the power
To decide on its length?
How long would you
Live in a moment
Before you choose to
Step into the next!
